notes.itemTitle: Follow up with Campus France Indonesia team
notes.text: Booking the Campus France interview is Critical and dated 10 Oct, but the only thing that moves it — chasing the Indonesia team — is sitting on a placeholder date of 14 Oct, four days after. Chase them this week, or move the interview date so the board stops saying you are on track.

Where does the SBI sanction stand — have they come back, or is it still sitting with the branch? It is dated 24 Oct and the 5 Nov instalment depends on it, and since nothing on your board carries a time estimate yet I am reminding you off the date alone, which is far too late for something that is mostly three weeks of their time.
